installed.description:
Installed is whether any item is set up to start at login (none before
the app is installed).

enabled.description:
Enabled is true when something is installed and every installed item
starts at login.

name.description: Name is ui (macOS's menu bar app, automator-ui; Linux's tray) or scheduler.

installed.description:
Installed is whether it's set up to start at login at all (the
install puts it there).

enabled.description: Enabled is whether it starts at login.

items.description: LoginItem is one thing that starts at login.
